description: Automatically find and export all SVG icons from a Figma file

fileId.description: Figma file ID to migrate SVGs from

inline.description: Return every SVG's markup in the response (structuredContent.results[].svg) instead of writing files. Default false locally, always true on a hosted server (nothing is written).

maxIcons.description: Export at most this many icon nodes (default: unlimited locally, 50 on a hosted server).

outputDir.description: Output directory for exported SVGs (default: $FIGMA_PROXY_SVG_DIR or ./exported-svgs relative to the server working directory; pass an absolute path to be explicit)

name: migrate_all_svgs
